headline: Bring HomeKit accessories home
intro: Connect compatible HomeKit accessories directly to Home Assistant over Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or Thread. The local HomeKit protocol works without an Apple account, so you can use supported lights, climate controls, sensors, and more as part of your home automations.
highlights: Pair accessories over IP, Bluetooth, or Thread
Use supported lights, climate devices, sensors, fans, and humidifiers in Home Assistant
Trigger automations from buttons, remotes, and other stateless accessories
